evidence.description: Successful GTFS Realtime probes with record_count=0 are also captured outside 01:00-05:00 MYT. The documented off-peak false-positive window remains valid but is not exhaustive.

live_signals.predicate: probe_outcome=success AND record_count=0 AND observed_at outside 01:00-05:00 MYT

impact_on_claim_or_decision: Consumers can incorrectly treat a successful zero-vehicle result outside the narrow off-peak window as an undocumented degradation.
resolution_or_quarantine: Retain the narrow off-peak false-positive rule and document the broader successful zero-vehicle signal separately.
rule_or_policy_change: The verifier requires each affected realtime feed to have a successful zero-record observation outside 01:00-05:00 MYT.

regression_test.description: A synthetic outside-window success with zero records is required for the signal.
